result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M for TrueLink’s data-processing activities, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. The force majeure provision remains unchanged. However, requiring every policy to continue for one year after termination is not in the playbook and is broader than necessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. Any post-termination requirement should be limited, if intended, to applicable claims-made coverages.
